status: Proposed acceptance and observability design; no new runtime integration tests executed

tests.inject: Trigger one due occurrence twice. / 同一次到期通知送兩次。
tests.expected: One accepted occurrence and one report; duplicate is recorded. / 只接受一次、送一份，重複有紀錄。

tests.case: No source change / 資料没變
tests.inject: Return the same monitor output twice. / 監看程式連續回傳相同內容。
tests.expected: For a configured pre-agent gate: second check starts no model turn and sends nothing. / 前置檢查模式下，第二次不啟動模型、不通知。

tests.case: Useful new mail / 需要提醒的新信
tests.inject: Provide a test mail with a deadline today. / 放入一封今天到期的測試郵件。
tests.expected: Read the actual message; show one reminder with its source link. / 讀實際郵件，提醒一次並附來源。

tests.inject: Send the same source event concurrently. / 同一來源事件同時重送。
tests.expected: One admitted task; no duplicate output. / 只接受一份工作，不重複產物。

tests.inject: Make the source adapter return an error. / 讓讀取工具回報錯誤。
tests.expected: Record an error, not “nothing new”; follow the retry policy. / 記錄讀取失敗，不能當作沒新信。

tests.inject: Fail the inbox write after successful analysis. / 分析成功後，讓收件匣寫入失敗。
tests.expected: Keep output pending; retry delivery without discarding it as already observed. / 保留待送成果，不因看過資料就丟掉。

tests.inject: Fail the first test run, pass the next. Also exhaust a budget. / 先失敗再通過；另測額度耗盡。
tests.expected: Continue only while eligible; stop on verified completion or enforced limit. / 可續跑才續跑，證明完成或超限即停。

tests.inject: Supply a real event plus a previously rejected similar proposal. / 提供真實事件及已退回的相似提案。
tests.expected: Check source, relevance, diversity and rejection separately; present only an eligible private proposal. / 來源、相關性、多樣性與退回條件各自檢查。

tests.inject: Stop after observation, after analysis and during delivery; restart each case. / 分別在觀察後、分析後、送達中重啟。
tests.expected: Recover the correct pending stage with stable IDs; no lost result or duplicate delivery. / 接回正確待辦階段，不漏結果、不重複送。

trace_scenarios.label: No new mail / 沒新信
steps: 09:00 check is due / 09:00 到檢查時間
Outlook list unchanged / 郵件清單沒變
Pre-agent gate skips work / 前置檢查略過
No model turn / 不啟動模型
No notification / 不通知
trace_scenarios.interpretation: A pre-agent watcher can stop here. A model-based heartbeat may still run a turn and choose silence; count these separately.
trace_scenarios.zh: 前置 watcher 可直接略過；靠模型判斷的 heartbeat 可能仍跑一輪才決定安靜，兩者要分開計算。

trace_scenarios.label: Urgent mail / 有急件
steps: Check or source event / 定時檢查或來源事件
New message ID / 新郵件 ID
Admit one task / 接受一份工作
Read mail and assess deadline / 讀信、判斷期限
Private reminder acknowledged / 私人提醒已送達
trace_scenarios.interpretation: A successful run is not enough: the reminder must reference the message and have a delivery acknowledgement.
trace_scenarios.zh: 工作成功還不夠：提醒要附上郵件來源，而且有送達確認。

trace_scenarios.label: Repeated event / 事件重送
steps: Same event arrives again / 同一事件又送來
Find existing occurrence / 找到既有事件紀錄
Mark duplicate / 記為重複
No new turn / 不多開回合
No repeated reminder / 不再提醒一次
trace_scenarios.interpretation: Deduplicate by a stable event identity before work begins. Changed content is a separate question.
trace_scenarios.zh: 工作開始前，用穩定事件 ID 去重；內容是否變更是另一個判斷。

trace_scenarios.label: Delivery failed / 通知失敗
steps: A new mail was accepted / 新郵件已接收
Agent produced the reminder / 同事已產生提醒
Inbox write failed / 收件匣寫入失敗
Keep delivery pending / 保留待送狀態
Retry and confirm / 重試並確認送達
trace_scenarios.interpretation: The observation checkpoint must not erase an undelivered result. Retry state belongs to delivery, not just source change detection.
trace_scenarios.zh: 不能因為已記住這封信，就丟掉尚未送達的結果。通知需要自己的重試狀態。

component_integration.change: Configure a supported schedule or connect the source webhook/polling adapter. Preserve event identity; validate, deduplicate and buffer before hand-off.
component_integration.change_zh: 沿用支援的排程，或接來源 webhook／輪詢程式。入口保存事件 ID，先驗證、去重、緩衝，再交給 runtime。
component_integration.verification: P1: receive a 09:00 occurrence once. P3: keep the original mail or ticket ID with the event.
component_integration.verification_zh: P1：09:00 那次工作只接一次。P3：保留原始郵件或案件 ID。

component_integration.change: Put Event Normalizer and Triage Policy here: ignore, deliver-only or start reasoning. Keep business triage out of Event Ingress. Attach goal continuation to the supported completion hook.
component_integration.change_zh: Event Normalizer 與 Triage Policy 放這裡：略過、直接顯示通知，或啟動推理。目標續跑接 runtime 支援的完成 hook；不要把業務判斷塞進事件入口。
component_integration.verification: P1: quiet and duplicate cases do not start unnecessary work. P2: only owned, unfinished goals within limits may continue.
component_integration.verification_zh: P1：沒事或重複事件不多叫一次。P2：只續跑自己負責、未完成且未超限的目標。

component_integration.change: Author the responsibility, available tools and expected output in our skills. For inbox triage: read the actual mail, identify a deadline and prepare a private reminder. Code and runtime controls enforce permissions and budgets.
component_integration.change_zh: 在我們的 skill 寫清責任、可用工具與產物。例如讀取實際郵件、辨認期限、準備私人提醒；權限與預算由程式及 runtime 強制執行。
component_integration.verification: P1: use the agreed report format. P2: supply the completion test. P3: every proposed task cites accepted source evidence.
component_integration.verification_zh: P1：產物格式正確。P2：有明確完成測試。P3：每個建議任務都能回到真實來源。

component_integration.change: Use the existing runtime adapter to bind the event or goal to a task and thread. Start the turn through the engine contract; consume completion and tool outcomes. Verify the chosen deployment exposes the continuation controls we need.
component_integration.change_zh: 沿用 runtime adapter，把事件或目標綁到 task 與 thread，再啟動工作、接收工具與完成結果。要查清所選部署是否真的提供需要的續跑控制。
component_integration.verification: P2: tests still fail → another allowed turn. Tests pass or budget is exhausted → no extra turn.
component_integration.verification_zh: P2：測試仍失敗且可續跑，才開下一輪；測試通過或額度用完就停止。

component_integration.change: Keep observation checkpoints, task outcomes and delivery status as separate records. Use stable identities for retries. A saved observation hash is not proof that the agent succeeded or the person received a result.
component_integration.change_zh: 觀察進度、工作成果、通知狀態要分開存，重試沿用穩定 ID。記住「這封信看過了」，不等於工作成功，更不等於人已收到通知。
component_integration.verification: P1: restart safely without duplicate reports. P2: preserve goal progress. P3: retain source anchors and rejection feedback.
component_integration.verification_zh: P1：重啟後不重複報告。P2：保留目標進度。P3：保留來源與退回意見。

component_integration.change: Connect the actual Outlook, SharePoint or ticket-reading tool and define its output contract. Keep unsolicited source events on the separate ingress path. Record tool success or failure, not just that a call was attempted.
component_integration.change_zh: 接好真正的 Outlook、SharePoint 或案件查詢工具，定義回傳資料。外部主動事件走另外的入口；工具紀錄要能分清有呼叫、成功與失敗。
component_integration.verification: P1: verify account access and source IDs. P3: proposal generation uses retrieved evidence. External actions follow the existing approval contract.
component_integration.verification_zh: P1：驗證帳號能讀到資料與來源 ID。P3：用讀到的證據產生提案；對外操作依既有核准契約。

component_integration.change: Show findings in the existing private inbox. Apply delivery and action policy before writes; record delivery acknowledgement separately from read or rejection feedback. Failed delivery needs an explicit recovery path.
component_integration.change_zh: 把發現放進既有私人收件匣，寫入前套用回報與操作政策。送達確認、已讀、退回分開記；送達失敗要有明確補送方式。
component_integration.verification: P1: one delivered report per occurrence. P3: proposals stay private and rejection affects subsequent suggestions.
component_integration.verification_zh: P1：同一次工作只送一份報告。P3：提案留在私人介面，退回意見能影響下次建議。
